case_scope: Kenya mobile-money and formal financial access as a payment-rail subsystem case

bank_account_payment_rail_access.note: Formal access and mobile-money infrastructure are strong relative to many peers.

digital_public_infrastructure_exclusion.note: Strong digital rails require checks for phone, ID, gender, rural, disability, and connectivity exclusion.

claim_conversion_friction.note: Payment rails can improve transfer and bill-payment conversion, but program-specific take-up and dispute data are needed.

intermediation_fee_leakage.note: Need cash-out, transfer, merchant, digital-credit, and fraud loss data by income and subgroup.

legal_identity_documentation_access.note: Need Kenya-specific identity and SIM/account access evidence by subgroup.

wealth_to_rule_risk.note: Dominant platform/payment-rail control could become tollbooth power if not regulated.

proof_debt: mobile-money and digital-credit fees by income and region
gender and disability wallet control data
public transfer receipt and cash-out costs

opening_package.second_lane: consumer protection for digital credit fees fraud and data use
opening_package.monitoring_lane: fee levels, digital debt, platform concentration, account freezes, fraud, and subgroup access

reopening_triggers: mobile-money fees rise for low-value transactions
agent/cash-out network weakens in rural areas
gender or disability gap in wallet control widens
dominant platform power creates new tollbooth fees

conversion_rails.why: Rails are strong enough for a positive subsystem score but require fee, exclusion, and dispute evidence.

anti_averaging.why: Digital access must be measured by gender, rurality, disability, age, ID, and device access.

washout.why: Digital credit, fees, fraud, and platform tolls can leak value.

evidence_debt_register.question: How much value is lost to fees, fraud, and cash-out costs at low transaction sizes?
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Central bank/provider fee data by transaction size and subgroup

evidence_debt_register.question: Who lacks phone, ID, SIM, or safe wallet control?
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: household survey and provider data by gender, rurality, disability, age, and income

validation_notes: Positive subsystem case; not a whole wealth-order pass.
